## Motivation

@humansand

Extend the existing W4A16 environment-variable documentation with its design and performance reference.

## Modifications

- **Reference:** Link *Faster-than-light NVFP4 decode—with precision*, by Ziang Li at humans& ai, from the existing `SGLANG_FLASHINFER_CUTEDSL_NVFP4_W4A16` entry.
- **Context:** Preserve the entry's precision, backend, and parallelism requirements.
- **Scope:** Documentation only; no settings, defaults, or inference behavior changed.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable. No executable source changes.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable; no runtime changes or GPU tests.

Validation:

```text
pre-commit run --files docs/docs/advanced_features/expert_parallelism.mdx docs/docs/references/environment_variables.mdx
All applicable hooks passed.
Final diff against base: documentation only.
git diff --check: passed.
Blog URL: HTTP 200.
```

`mint broken-links` and `mint validate` could not run because the Mintlify CLI is not installed.

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). (Not applicable: comments/docs only.)
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (Not applicable: no runtime changes.)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

files.patch: @@ -816,7 +816,7 @@ SGLang supports various environment variables that can be used to configure its SGLANG_FLASHINFER_CUTEDSL_NVFP4_W4A16 - Use BF16 activations and outputs with FlashInfer CuTe DSL NVFP4 weights on NVIDIA SM100-family GPUs (SM100/SM103). Serialized dense linear layers use this mode with --fp4-gemm-backend flashinfer_cutedsl. With --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_cutedsl, MoE layers support online weight quantization and serialized ModelOpt NVFP4 weights with either no A2A or FlashInfer A2A, and honor SGLANG_FLASHINFER_MOE_FUSED_FINALIZE. With --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_megamoe --moe-a2a-backend flashinfer_megamoe, MoE layers support serialized ModelOpt NVFP4 weights and --quantization nvfp4_online for gated SiLU/SwiGLU or SiTU. MegaMOE uses BF16 activations and combine, with equal TP, attention-DP, and EP sizes. + Use BF16 activations and outputs with FlashInfer CuTe DSL NVFP4 weights on NVIDIA SM100-family GPUs (SM100/SM103). Serialized dense linear layers use this mode with --fp4-gemm-backend flashinfer_cutedsl. With --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_cutedsl, MoE layers support online weight quantization and serialized ModelOpt NVFP4 weights with either no A2A or FlashInfer A2A, and honor SGLANG_FLASHINFER_MOE_FUSED_FINALIZE. With --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_megamoe --moe-a2a-backend flashinfer_megamoe, MoE layers support serialized ModelOpt NVFP4 weights and --quantization nvfp4_online for gated SiLU/SwiGLU or SiTU. MegaMOE uses BF16 activations and combine, with equal TP, attention-DP, and EP sizes. For more on the W4A16 MoE design and performance, see Faster-than-light NVFP4 decode—with precision by Ziang Li at humans& ai. false
